These are separate single-process Nsys captures, so neither delta replaces the release benchmark nor proves causal attribution for every unchanged row.

release_performance_anchor.method: fixed-frequency P19/C32/max26 B1-C1-C2-B2, one warmup and five measured generations per process, arithmetic mean of mirrored process medians
release_performance_anchor.note: The 109.695766-ms profiled host-range average and 109.000897-ms GPU raw time per Decode step are profiler-run diagnostics, not replacement latency or throughput measurements.

reasons: The first three groups still account for 75.746379% of Decode raw kernel time.
Decode remains one stream with raw equal to union, zero overlap, and only 0.635725% idle in the associated kernel span.
The release anchor is 109.056 ms/token and 9.169600939 token/s, leaving 9.056 ms/token to the single-request target.
The promoted gate/up topology is present in all 1,600 expected Decode launches; the 64x256 predecessor is absent.
mechanism_boundary: This profile does not revive previously rejected gate/up, QKV/Z-sidecar, or down CTA-prune candidates.
A next implementation still requires its own exactness, topology, resource, microbenchmark, model-oracle, and mirrored end-to-end gates.
General batch-one double/triple buffering has no measured same-request overlap opportunity in this single-stream dependency chain.
priority_decision.prefill_policy: Resume the larger Prefill program after the 100-ms/token and 10-token/s single-request Decode target is met.

artifacts.role: route and closure supplemental audit JSON

limitations: This is one profiled P19/C32/max26 process with no warmup, not a latency distribution, release SLA, or end-to-end promotion gate.
Nsight Systems perturbs absolute latency; this trace selects hotspots and audits topology. The separate fixed-frequency B1-C1-C2-B2 result is the release performance anchor.
The predecessor/current Nsys comparison uses different binaries and processes. Profiler and run drift prevent assigning the complete raw or host-range delta causally to the CTA coarsen.

Nsight's localMemoryTotal=14155776 launch-context field is identical to the predecessor report and is not a spill metric. The same-binary CUDA resource query reports local_bytes=0, supported by normalized SASS.
No Nsight Compute counters, fresh EMC readback, power, energy, thermal-soak, long-context, tail-latency, or multi-request evidence was collected.
The short trace contains only one 18-token prefix tile; it is intentionally not used to rank Prefill.

Prefill and Decode remain logically separate but dependency-serialized for one request; no general double/triple buffer, independent executor, or cross-request scheduler is implemented by this profile.
